name: @repo/image-generation-panel
description: A text-to-image generation console — prompt and settings up top, a full-width 2x2 batch resolving from low-res mosaic to sharp below.

useCases: Text-to-image generation panel for an AI product
Prompt composer with style presets and a result grid
Any surface that queues work and reveals tiles as they complete
compositionHints: Leave status undefined to let the panel run its own state machine around onGenerate
Drive progress from 0 to 1 while the batch renders — every tile derives its own staggered resolve from it
Set images as soon as generation starts, not at the end, so tiles fill progressively
Pass a tiny preview (16-48px) per image for the blocky first pass
Set typing to replay a prompt into the field with a caret
Pass onCancel to turn the composer's send control into a stop button while a batch renders
